Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the anatomy and spatial relationship of the TABLET AND HANDS in this Yukio animation strip.
Preserve her exact white-haired blue-eyed identity, navy maid-butler outfit, head size, seated posture, legs/boots, desk/chair design, camera and clean anime rendering. Input image is the existing 4-frame animation with a WRONG pose: index finger is touching the BACK of an upright tablet.
Make a corrected 2 COLUMN x 2 ROW sheet (four equal square cells, reading order 0,1,2,3), square1024x1024, uniform solid #FF00FF background, no labels/grid. Entire seated character, desk legs and chair fit inside each cell with ~25px margins. Same master drawing repeated, head/body/desk/boots locked across all4.
CORRECT PHYSICAL POSE: The tablet is held LOW OVER THE TABLE, nearly horizontal and gently tilted up toward her face, with its FRONT SCREEN uppermost. From our slightly elevated front camera we can see the screen as a shallow trapezoid, displaying a pale webpage with a small blue header and a few abstract gray horizontal lines, no readable text. There is NO REAR CAMERA DOT on the visible front screen. She looks downward at this screen. Her anatomical LEFT hand (viewer right) supports the tablet UNDER its viewer-right side/bottom edge, fingers curl beneath the edge, not through the glass. Her anatomical RIGHT forearm (viewer left) comes forward naturally from its elbow on the desk; the right index fingertip reaches OVER and gently touches the UPPER SCREEN SURFACE. Right wrist is neutral and naturally connected to forearm. Other right fingers curve relaxed above the near edge. Show a clear occlusion hierarchy: supporting fingers underneath tablet edge, operating fingertip over screen; no fingers on tablet back, no backwards hand, no impossible wrist, no hands detached from sleeves.
Frame0: right index touches near lower part of screen.
Frame1: right index slides 1px toward screen upper part at final192px display scale.
Frame2: right index slides another1px.
Frame3: same as frame0.
The tablet's size, angle, position and screen content remain EXACTLY fixed in all4. Hands stay same size. No torso or head movement, no breathing animation, no changing furniture geometry. Change only hands/tablet and necessary forearm pose. Solid uniform MAGENTA for all background gaps.
